title: Том 1 — литературная вычитка, партия 7 (разделы 31–35)
policy: Russian prose editorial revision only. Preserve Arabic source, author arguments, Quran and hadith quotations, paragraph and section IDs. Historical theological claims and polemics stay attributed to the author.
